# P05 (process)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl df9d809be53dcd44

The room keeps its placed work against erosion: members watch it and repair changed pixels, and the room rallies to defend it under attack, covers the night, hardens its shape and puts upkeep before growth. Repair restores the form the keepers know. A change the room has planned or agreed (P02) is therefore repaired away as damage until its keepers are told of it, and it is lost or given up where the telling does not reach them.

tier ['T4-013']; dimension ['D03']; status standing; since C2-pass-1
